parent_objective: design outcome-semantics instrumentation before interpreting M1693 controller-family diagnostics
blocked_by: M1693 has 794 terminated non-collision non-completion rows without termination reason, so raw success is not interpretable enough for ranking
supersedes: direct controller-family ranking from M1693 raw success
direct recurrent-advantage claim from M1693 L3/L2 comparisons

public_gates: M1695 must design but not yet execute the outcome-semantics instrumentation route
M1695 must identify which termination/completion fields are missing from M1693 rows
M1695 must preserve the P0 actor input contract and keep instrumentation in info/logging only
M1695 must specify whether the next step is a lightweight re-run, a replay-free row relabel, or an instrumentation implementation
M1695 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, or level3 self-ID
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune profiles from M1693 diagnostics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the instrumentation needed to interpret M1693 non-collision non-completion outcomes
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: instrumentation design only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if the design would add actor inputs
stop if termination reason cannot be logged without changing policy behavior
stop if the design does not distinguish collision, obstacle pass, off-track, speed, yaw-rate, non-finite, and max-step outcomes
stop if it still permits direct ranking from M1693 raw success
fallback_plan: route to instrumentation implementation if design is clean
route to task-definition audit if success/completion semantics are ambiguous
route to branch synthesis if the current workload is judged unsuitable for controller-family comparison
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1694 identifies outcome semantics as the blocker

admission_evidence: M1694 audits M1693 and finds 794 terminated non-collision non-completion rows without termination reason
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1695 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up instrumentation implementation or task-definition audit manifest
next_stage_criteria: termination and completion fields are specified
next implementation or audit route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1695 is instrumentation design and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design must preserve L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset comparison rows for later audit
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1694 audit of M1693 public rollout.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If instrumented rerun still shows reset/current-tiled controls matching history profiles, record that as a history-necessity gap rather than weakening the claim standard.
allowed_claims: no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A logging-only termination/completion instrumentation design can make the M1693-style rollout interpretable without changing actor inputs or policy behavior.
success_criteria: design preserves actor input contract and changes logging/info only
design states whether rerun or row relabel is required
training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design cannot distinguish dominant M1693 non-collision non-completion outcomes
design allows ranking from raw M1693 success without instrumentation
design routes directly to training or profile tuning
training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: design
commands.command: write outcome-semantics instrumentation design without executing rollout

decision_rule: M1695 passes if it writes a logging-only outcome-semantics instrumentation design and routes to a follow-up implementation or task-definition audit without overclaiming.
